skill.displayName: 卖家精灵-市场调研（列表）

llm.summary: The skill has a real SellerSprite market-research purpose, but it adds credential-sensitive routing, mandatory local retention, automatic feedback reporting, and a runtime dependency-install path that users should review.

dimensions.detail: The main API call, API key use, paid-credit warning, and large-response handling fit the market-research purpose; automatic feedback reporting and downloading another onboarding skill are secondary behaviors that go beyond producing market research.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger covers generic Amazon category market-research requests even when SellerSprite is not named, which can surprise users because the skill may consume credits, contact external services, and persist full responses.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install-time execution is shown, but the runtime troubleshooting instructions tell the agent to download and install a separate linkfox-onboarding skill package from an external LinkFox URL if it is missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Calling a LinkFox gateway with an environment-provided API key is expected, but LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY can redirect the request while the script sends Authorization, SESSION_ID, MODE_ID, and APP_NAME headers to that host.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill unconditionally writes full API responses, cache files, and session metadata locally; this is disclosed, but mandatory retention of business research data is broader than necessary, and the script can fall back to home or temp paths despite stricter wording in SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust LinkFox/SellerSprite and are comfortable with paid-credit API calls and full market-research responses being stored locally. Keep LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY unset unless you control the destination, review or disable automatic feedback behavior, and do not allow the skill to install the onboarding package unless you intentionally want that extra skill added.
llm.findings:
[TT3] expected: Accepted as a material routing concern: a network POST with an API key is expected, but the destination is controlled by LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY without an allowlist.
[LP3] expected: Downgraded from a standalone issue: the docs do disclose env, network, and file behavior, but the frontmatter does not clearly surface those permissions.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: automatic feedback submission to a separate endpoint is not required for market research and is not presented as opt-in.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: runtime download and installation of another skill package is outside the core research workflow and creates supply-chain review risk.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially accepted: Amazon category market research is related to the stated purpose, but the broad trigger matters because usage can incur credits and persistence.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted as a persistence concern: saving full responses supports large-result workflows, but it is mandatory and session-organized.
[SQP-2] expected: Low weight: the curl example uses an environment variable rather than a literal key, but command-line Authorization examples can still leak in logs or process views.
[SSD-3] expected: Accepted as overlapping with the local-retention concern rather than a separate malicious signal.
[staticScan] expected: The supplied static scan was clean, so it does not add negative evidence.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and is treated only as supporting telemetry, not as the final classifier.
